title: multi check reads the claim window a real research agent leaves: a coord.py claim and release with no claim or release event
goal: claim_windows (bench_multi.py) finds the window of a research key that coord.py claim then coord.py release left in a store, with no claim or release event posted, so duplicate research of a paid run whose agents release properly is named

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import os, re, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
B = os.path.join(T, 'bin'); os.mkdir(B)
open(os.path.join(B, 'claude'), 'w').write('#!/bin/sh\nexit 1\n')
os.chmod(os.path.join(B, 'claude'), 0o755)
ENV = dict(os.environ, PATH=B + os.pathsep + os.environ['PATH'])
def bench(*a):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/benchmarks.py', *a], capture_output=True, text=True, env=ENV, timeout=1800)
import json, bench_multi
s = os.path.join(T, 'c.sqlite')
c = json.loads(subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/coord.py', '--store', s, 'claim', 'research:public/ad/x:term1', '--ttl', '60', '--holder', 'a'], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout)
subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/coord.py', '--store', s, 'release', 'research:public/ad/x:term1', '--token', c['token']], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
w = bench_multi.claim_windows(s)
shutil.rmtree(T, ignore_errors=True)
assert w, 'a claimed and released research key leaves no claim window'

notes: Review of SP-7s6uubs7, S2: coord.py claim and release post no events and a released row is deleted, so only the replay's hand-posted events make the duplicate-research check fire (bench_multi.py claim_windows).
